mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
